verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AnythingLLM runs entirely on-device or self-hosted via Docker, with no data leaving the device and local/private defaults (cloud components are opt-in). That implies the user owns and physically controls stored data. However, no evidence documents explicit retention settings or deletion features. Missing for 10: documented retention policies or settings, chat/document/workspace deletion controls, admin-level purge or retention enforcement, and independent corroboration of deletion behavior.
